gpu: GeForce GTX 980 Ti, 6144 MB (Maxwell, CC 5.2) - CUDA only, no Vulkan compute path needed for mining

standby.label: etchash mining (GTX 980 Ti)
standby.note: Measured on this box 2026-11-09: SRBMiner 3.8.6 refuses Maxwell (CUDA 'not on list of supported devices'); lolMiner 1.98a accepts the card, builds the 4447 MB etchash DAG in 7.8 s, pool authorizes the worker. Rate is 1.53 MH/s where the card class does 25-30 - the build is the suspect, not the card. after=1800 is the operator's 30-minute quiet rule.
